slug: 2024-08-23 Central Bank of Comoros commences PAPSS implementation

facts.fact: The Banque Centrale des Comores signed a PAPSS membership agreement in July 2024 and PAPSS implementation in Comoros commenced on 23 August 2024, with commercial banks to begin integrating, per Afreximbank.
